reviews.text: Now they're forcing customers to pay a $50 monthly subscription that doesn't offer the customer anything at all. If you don't sign up they're forcing a $35 non member fee for every service. Horrible business decision they're opening the door for their competitors to take their business!

My 11month S.A Boerboel had an appt here today. I must say the staff was attentive, kind and understanding, from the front desk Rosa who was very kind, to my dogs groomer Brittany, and the other young guy apologies I didn't get his name. Any who the service and grooming was great, I was happy they were able to take my 140lb male boerboel, its hard finding a groomer that will deal with this breed. I reached out many leaving messges, with refusal of taking him because of his size and type of breed. Brittany was able to read my dogs body language and did a slow approach til she saw fit he was comfortable. She made me feel comfortable that my dog will be in good hands. I know he is alot to handle but she handle this massive breed like it was nothing

Hyde Park location ROCKS!!!  Demetrius did an excellent job cutting Olivia!!!  They were great to accommodate her being the first and only groom first thing in the morning.  Olivia has a hard time with other dogs, so that was important to me, that they did that.

EDITED: If I could give zero stars I would!! Dropped my Yorkie off Wednesday and the groomer told me to be patient with her because she had a few dogs and she was the only groomer. Picked my dog up and his eyes were red. Now initially I thought maybe some shampoo got in his eyes or being around other dogs irritated them. It is Friday and his eye shouldn’t still be red if that’s the case because it isn’t. He had a cut above his eye and I know that groomer knew she cut him because I know he gave a reaction when she did. I will NEVER bring my dog here again. I should’ve known when I walked in something wasn’t right. The place is just dull, floors dirty, no friendly greeting or customer service because the girl was too busy on her phone with her feet kicked up. $110 for a a bs hair cut and literally another cut! And another thing, if multiple customers have the same problem then YALL are the problem! Take accountability for YOUR mistake instead of talking bs and being defensive through comments on reviews. I will be filing an official report

I must say I had trouble with my 8 month puppy trying to get him somewhere to get a bath, get his nail trim, and teeth cleaning. Some places do bath with large breeds Monday thru Friday only but luckily I ran to this place and I got to say it was a great experience for me! They did a really great job 👏🏼 I recommend for pet owners to go here! Thank you once again! 🐶 🐕

HONEST REVIEW- I MADE an appointment, PAID a DEPOSIT & drove over an hour away to get my dog special color service. I walked in the shop, advised I had an app, she confirmed the app, but stated the “NEW secretary” should NOT have booked me for color. She called the groomer out to confirm if she can service my dog. The groomer walked out the door & said “ You trying to get this done today” I responded I made an appointment, paid a deposit & drove an hour to get this done on my off day” she said “ The new person messed up” and stated she would take my dog & still do a color” I left went to have lunch only for them to call me less than a hour late to say they CAN’T DO ANYTHING to my dog because the groomer had to leave, but they stated she gave my dog a bath & I would get my deposit back in 2-3 days. I requested a call from the manager who she claimed she spoke with & agreed to give me deposit back in cash, but never thought to say they would service my dog another day. I tried to support the business, but this business does not support their customers.
The customer service is great. They explained the service well and my poodle has a permanent groomer now.

I can’t say enough good things about Puppy Haberdashery! From the moment we walked in, I knew Bryson—my standard golden doodle—was in great hands. The team was incredibly welcoming and took the time to get to know both of us. Bryson can be a bit wiggly, but they were so patient, gentle, and clearly experienced with doodle coats.

When I picked him up, I was blown away! His curls were perfectly trimmed, soft, and fluffy—he looked like a teddy bear. They even added an adorable accessory to his collar, which made the whole thing feel like a VIP spa day.

What really stood out was the care and love they put into every detail. The salon was clean, stylish, and had such a fun, happy vibe. Bryson left happy, relaxed, and looking fabulous—and I left knowing we’d found our forever groomers.

Thank you, Puppy Haberdashery, for making Bryson look (and feel) his best! We can’t wait for our next visit!
